run.procedureSummary: Feed: add that cycle's row to each chamber, ignoring capacity. Carry: go through chambers 1 to 6 in order. Any amount above a chamber's capacity is cut back to capacity and added to the next chamber before that chamber's turn, so it can cascade. Chamber 6's excess goes to the tally. States: these use the mass after carry. LARVAL with mass at or above its upper mark becomes PUPAL. PUPAL with mass at or below its lower mark becomes LARVAL. Otherwise the state stays the same, and every change is logged. Metabolise: take all amounts from the post-carry masses and the new states, then apply them at the same time. LARVAL loses floor(m/4) to the tally. PUPAL loses floor(m/2) to chamber i-1, and chamber 1's PUPAL amount goes to the tally. There is no capacity check here, because overfull chambers wait for the next cycle's carry. Moult: if the six chambers total more than 38 (strictly), each chamber becomes floor(m/2) and the removed part (ceil(m/2)) goes to the tally. A short Python script did the arithmetic (C:\Users\USER\AppData\Local\Temp\om\desk-250\sim.py). I also checked cycles 1 and 2 by hand.

openPoints.point: Moult rounding: 'halve each, rounding down' could mean keeping floor(m/2) or removing floor(m/2).
openPoints.assumption: The kept amount is floor(m/2) and the removed amount is ceil(m/2), which goes to the tally. Under the other reading, cycle 1 would keep 4,5,5,3,2,2.

openPoints.point: Moult threshold boundary: the cycle 5 total after metabolise is exactly 38.
openPoints.assumption: 'Over 38' means strictly greater than 38, so no moult in cycle 5.

openPoints.point: Which mass the state test uses.
openPoints.assumption: The state test uses the mass after carry, since steps run in order.
It uses the state just set in the States step of the same cycle.
Each chamber's amount is rounded down on its own (floor(m/4) or floor(m/2)) before transfer.

openPoints.point: A PUPAL transfer can push the receiving chamber over capacity.
openPoints.assumption: It is allowed. The extra is held until the next cycle's Carry, and nothing is carried after metabolise or moult.
It goes to the loss tally, as the write-up states.
